info.title: GlucoTwin research API
info.description: Student research proof of concept. Recorded-data replay and synthetic demonstration only; not for clinical use.

get.description: Server-side filtering and stable sorting; ``total`` counts every match, not just this page.

Session, warnings and latest forecast from one sync under one lock, so a playing replay cannot advance
between them: every part carries the same revision and clock.
Headline results of the research run after the demo model was chosen; none of it is the demo model.

meaning.title: Meaning
meaning.default: Marked as reviewed in this local research session. No message was sent to anyone.

episode_start_to_onset_minutes.title: Episode Start To Onset Minutes
episode_start_to_onset_minutes.description: Onset minus the first warning of the merged episode. Can exceed the horizon.

qualified_lead_minutes.title: Qualified Lead Minutes
qualified_lead_minutes.description: Onset minus the earliest firing whose own horizon contains the onset (0 < x <= H).

start_at.title: Start At
start_at.description: Initial replay clock. Defaults to the start of the timeline.

summary_sentence.title: Summary Sentence
summary_sentence.description: Rendered only from verified assessed counts; null when they are not available.

snapshot_commit.title: Snapshot Commit
snapshot_commit.description: Git commit the snapshot was exported from.

corrects_experiment_id.title: Corrects Experiment Id
corrects_experiment_id.description: Earlier experiment this one corrects; that test segment was already inspected.

selection_disclosures.title: Selection Disclosures
selection_disclosures.description: Statements that qualify how the serving model was chosen, e.g. an eligibility constraint declared after the test segment had been inspected.

error_by_trend.description: Serving pipeline's error by glucose trend on its validation segment (scripts/error_by_trend.py); descriptive, the test segment is not used.

is_serving_evidence.title: Is Serving Evidence
is_serving_evidence.description: True only for the experiment that produced the serving model.

glucose_trend_mg_dl_per_min.title: Glucose Trend Mg Dl Per Min
glucose_trend_mg_dl_per_min.description: Least-squares slope of native readings over the 15 minutes before the origin (the slope_15 feature); null with fewer than three readings.

split_segment.title: Split Segment
split_segment.description: Evaluation segment that contains this origin. 'training' origins are in-sample for the model.

public_demo.title: Public Demo
public_demo.description: True when this server is the public synthetic demonstration: synthetic participants only, sessions private to each visitor's browser, limited and expiring.

consumed_forecast_ids.title: Consumed Forecast Ids
consumed_forecast_ids.description: Most recent forecast IDs whose matured residuals feed the state.

evaluation_segments.title: Evaluation Segments
evaluation_segments.description: Chronological split segments for participants in the measured evaluation. Forecasts issued in the training segment are in-sample for the population model.

total.title: Total
total.description: Participants matching the filters (all pages), not the size of this page.

total_unfiltered.title: Total Unfiltered
total_unfiltered.description: Participants in the catalogue before filtering.

PatientSummary.title: PatientSummary
PatientSummary.description: Catalogue entry. Contains identifiers and field-availability metadata, never clinical values.

cap_mg_dl.title: Cap Mg Dl
cap_mg_dl.description: Largest correction the policy can apply in either direction (null when disabled).

reset_gap_minutes.title: Reset Gap Minutes
reset_gap_minutes.description: A gap between readings longer than this clears the learned correction.

session_idle_minutes.title: Session Idle Minutes
session_idle_minutes.description: A replay session unused for this long is removed.

max_sessions_per_visitor.title: Max Sessions Per Visitor
max_sessions_per_visitor.description: Starting one more evicts the visitor's least recently used.

ReasonCode.title: ReasonCode
ReasonCode.description: Machine-readable code plus a plain-language explanation.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: Wall-clock creation time of the session (not replay time).

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Replay minutes advanced per wall-clock second while playing.

key.title: Key
key.description: Which result: forecast_120, notice_120, profile_inputs_120, classifier, ranges_120, earlier_warning_120, profile_prior_120.

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: How this page describes the result. shown: the 95 % interval lies wholly on the favourable side (ranges: pooled coverage moved closer to the 80 % target; notice: median lead of at least 60 min); not_shown: it does not; negative: rejected by its own report. See basis: most verdicts are display descriptions, not pass bars a protocol declared.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: declared_rule: the protocol fixed this claim rule before computing (only D-046 part C); display_heuristic: this page's description of the saved interval or diagnostic.

basis_note.title: Basis Note
basis_note.description: The rule or heuristic in words.

ResearchFinding.title: ResearchFinding
ResearchFinding.description: One headline result of a research experiment, read from its saved summary (numbers only; the UI words them).

mae_high_glucose_target.title: Mae High Glucose Target
mae_high_glucose_target.description: Macro MAE on origins whose target exceeded 180 mg/dL (people with >= 20 such origins).

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Share of target-bearing origins that received a forecast. Not accuracy.

source.description: published_snapshot: read from reports/public_evidence/ because this installation has no saved experiment artifacts (public demonstration only). Absent: the saved artifacts.

snapshot_commit.title: Snapshot Commit
snapshot_commit.description: Git commit the snapshot was exported from.

ResearchReport.title: ResearchReport
ResearchReport.description: Nested participant-level research experiment (internal folds + reserved external cohort).

status.title: Status
status.description: available: read in full; not_run: no saved summary on this installation; malformed: the file is not readable JSON; incompatible: it belongs to another experiment or lacks fields this page reads.

status_detail.title: Status Detail
status_detail.description: Why a summary is malformed or incompatible.

ResearchSummaryList.title: ResearchSummaryList
ResearchSummaryList.description: Research experiments run after the demo model was chosen (20 Oct 2026). None of them is the demo model.

ReviewSnapshot.title: ReviewSnapshot
ReviewSnapshot.description:
One session read under one lock at one replay clock: the session, its warnings and its latest forecast.

Used by the review queue so that every value in a row describes the same session, revision and cutoff.

requires_complete_profile.title: Requires Complete Profile
requires_complete_profile.description: True when the model abstains unless every baseline profile value it reads is available.

profile_inputs.title: Profile Inputs
profile_inputs.description: Names of the baseline profile values this model reads as inputs (empty when it reads none); other profile values are context only.

SessionProfile.title: SessionProfile
SessionProfile.description: Baseline values as known at the session clock. Future values are withheld.

slope_min.title: Slope Min
slope_min.description: Exclusive lower bound, mg/dL per minute.

slope_max.title: Slope Max
slope_max.description: Inclusive upper bound, mg/dL per minute.

mae_macro.title: Mae Macro
mae_macro.description: Macro per-participant MAE; null below min_participants.
